defs.def: the process of discussing sb/sth; a conversation about sb/sth 讨论；商讨

ex.s: After a heated discussion that lasted for what seemed like a century, Gunter put his phone down and started the car.
ex.t: 在一场似乎持续了一个世纪的激烈讨论后，冈特放下手机，发动了车。

ex.s: After a heated discussion that lasted for what seemed like a century, Gunter put his phone down and started the car.
ex.t: 在一场似乎持续了一个世纪的激烈讨论后，冈特放下手机，发动了车。

ex.s: The key finding of the study was that when crowds were further divided into smaller groups that were allowed to have a discussion, the averages from these groups were more accurate than those from an equal number of independent individuals.
ex.t: 这项研究的关键发现是，当人群被进一步分成可以进行讨论的小组时，这些小组的平均值比同等数量的独立个体的平均值更准确。

ex.s: For instance, the average obtained from the estimates of four discussion groups of five was significantly more accurate than the average obtained from 20 independent individuals.
ex.t: 例如，由四个五人讨论小组得出的平均估算值，明显比由20个独立个体得出的平均值更准确。

ex.s: In a follow-up study with 100 university students, the researchers tried to get a better sense of what the group members actually did in their discussion.
ex.t: 在一项以100名大学生为对象的后续研究中，研究人员试图更清楚地了解小组成员在讨论中实际做了什么。

ex.s: The discussion process.
ex.t: 讨论的过程。

ex.s: Class activities will vary from day to day, but students must be ready to complete short in-class writings or tests drawn directly from assigned readings or notes from the previous class' lecture/discussion, so it is important to take careful notes during class.
ex.t: 课堂活动每天不同，但学生必须准备好完成直接取自指定阅读或上节课讲座/讨论笔记的简短课堂写作或测试，所以课堂上认真记笔记很重要。

ex.s: After long discussions we somehow agreed to do a study on the psychological well-being of teenagers.
ex.t: 经过长时间讨论，我们不知怎的同意做一项关于青少年心理健康的研究。

ex.s: It is easier to avoid a discussion，but risking talking about it may eventually lead to a better outcome．
ex.t: 避开讨论更容易，但冒险谈出来最终可能会带来更好的结果。

ex.s: But all of today's excited discussion about these possibilities presupposes the fact that we will be able to build these systems.
ex.t: 但今天关于这些可能性的所有兴奋讨论，都预设了我们将能够建造这些系统这一事实。

ex.s: Introduce a new topic for discussion.
ex.t: 引入一个新的讨论话题。

ex.s: [Now look for more sentences with -ed as attributive in the reading passage.] [② Read the discussion between two students about Ryan’s foundation.
ex.t: [现在在阅读材料中找更多-ed作定语的句子。] [② 阅读两个学生关于Ryan基金会的讨论。

ex.s: While some say contemporary art lacks skill, meaning and artistic value, others argue that its worth lies in its ability to stimulate new discussions and understanding of everyday objects.
ex.t: 虽然有人说当代艺术缺乏技巧、意义和艺术价值，但其他人认为它的价值在于能激发关于日常物品的新讨论和新理解。

ex.s: Here in our city, there is a heated discussion about whether a hotel should be built at White Beach.
ex.t: 在我们城市，关于是否应该在白沙滩建一家酒店正在进行激烈讨论。

ex.s: Now think about your performance during the group discussion.
ex.t: 现在想想你在小组讨论中的表现。

ex.s: Talk about another phenomenon of the global village using the expressions in this section.] Now think about any difficulties you encountered during your discussion and what you did to overcome them.
ex.t: 用这一部分的表达方式谈谈地球村的另一个现象。] 现在想想你在讨论中遇到的任何困难以及你是如何克服它们的。

ex.s: In a class discussion, I was invited to explain the meaning of my name.
ex.t: 在一次课堂讨论中，我被邀请解释我名字的含义。

ex.s: Allow them to lead discussions and meetings to develop their communication skills.
ex.t: 让他们主导讨论和会议，以培养他们的沟通技能。

ex.s: Be sure to schedule set times to watch your lectures, read materials and contribute to online discussion boards.
ex.t: 不同文化间道德美德的相似性令人瞩目，尽管各种美德的重要性排序可能因社会群体的历史和环境而异。

ex.s: You can also find students on the class discussion board to organize a study group, or schedule in-person meetings with your professor to discuss course concepts.
ex.t: 你也可以在课堂讨论板上找同学组建学习小组，或约教授当面讨论课程概念。

ex.s: Restrictions on group discussion.
ex.t: 对小组讨论的限制。

ex.s: brought under discussionD.taken into account
ex.t: 提上议程D. 考虑在内

ex.s: Although the studies led by Navajas have limitations and many questions remain the potential implications for group discussion and decision-making are enormous.
ex.t: 尽管纳瓦哈斯主导的研究存在局限性且仍有许多问题未解决，但其对小组讨论和决策的潜在影响是巨大的。

ex.s: In part one, I describe the philosophical foundations of digital minimalism, starting with an examination of the forces that are making so many people’s digital lives increasingly intolerable, before moving on to a detailed discussion of the digital minimalism philosophy.
ex.t: 在第一部分，我阐述了数字极简主义的哲学基础，先审视那些让许多人的数字生活越来越难以忍受的力量，接着详细讨论数字极简主义理念。

ex.s: Readers will encounter not only stories they have heard before, but some new stories and a moving discussion of the responsibility of the engineer to the public and the ways young engineers can be helped to grasp them.
ex.t: 读者不仅会读到他们以前听过的故事，还会读到一些新故事，以及关于工程师对公众的责任、以及如何帮助年轻工程师理解这些责任的感人讨论。

defs.def: a speech or a piece of writing that discusses many different aspects of a subject 详述；论述
